summary.zh: 分析帖子表现，区分规律与波动
summary.en: Analyze LinkedIn post performance and spot patterns.

description.zh: 复盘已发布帖子的表现，解释触达下降的原因，判断某个现象是真实规律还是偶然波动。也会为仍存疑的猜想设计小规模测试。适合定期复盘，或怀疑账号被限流时使用。
description.en: Reviews how published posts performed, explains a drop in reach and separates a real pattern from noise. It also designs small tests for open questions. Use it for regular reviews or when reach suddenly falls.
